schema lys owner=lys_owner acl=lys_app=U/lys_owner lys_owner=UC/lys_owner lys_reader=U/lys_owner
default privileges for=lys_owner on=S acl=lys_app=rU/lys_owner
default privileges for=lys_owner on=r acl=lys_app=arwd/lys_owner lys_reader=r/lys_owner
type channel_action owner=lys_owner enum=grant,revoke,ban,unban
type request_status owner=lys_owner enum=new,in_progress,completed,rejected
function lys.create_twitch_settings_entry() owner=lys_owner
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION lys.create_twitch_settings_entry()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO lys.twitch_settings (user_id)
    VALUES (NEW.user_id)
    ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

function lys.log_twitch_channel_changes() owner=lys_owner
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION lys.log_twitch_channel_changes()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_action lys.channel_action;
BEGIN
    -- Case 1: New channel added -> always log 'grant'
    IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
        INSERT INTO lys.twitch_channel_events (user_id, username, action)
        VALUES (NEW.user_id, NEW.username, 'grant'::lys.channel_action);
        RETURN NEW;
    END IF;

    -- Case 2: Updates to 'active' or 'banned'
    IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
        -- If 'active' changed, log grant/revoke
        IF NEW.active IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.active THEN
            v_action := CASE WHEN NEW.active
                             THEN 'grant'::lys.channel_action
                             ELSE 'revoke'::lys.channel_action
                        END;
            INSERT INTO lys.twitch_channel_events (user_id, username, action)
            VALUES (NEW.user_id, NEW.username, v_action);
        END IF;

        -- If 'banned' changed, log ban/unban
        IF NEW.banned IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.banned THEN
            v_action := CASE WHEN NEW.banned
                             THEN 'ban'::lys.channel_action
                             ELSE 'unban'::lys.channel_action
                        END;
            INSERT INTO lys.twitch_channel_events (user_id, username, action)
            VALUES (NEW.user_id, NEW.username, v_action);
        END IF;

        RETURN NEW;
    END IF;

    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

table feature_requests owner=lys_owner acl=lys_app=arwd/lys_owner lys_owner=arwdDxt/lys_owner lys_reader=r/lys_owner
  column id bigint not null default nextval('lys.feature_requests_id_seq'::regclass)
  column occurred_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  column user_id text not null
  column username text not null
  column channel_id text not null
  column channel_name text not null
  column platform text not null
  column body text not null
  column status lys.request_status not null default 'new'::lys.request_status
  constraint feature_requests_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  index CREATE INDEX feature_requests_occurred_at_desc_idx ON lys.feature_requests USING btree (occurred_at DESC)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX feature_requests_pkey ON lys.feature_requests USING btree (id)
table game_events owner=lys_owner acl=lys_app=arwd/lys_owner lys_owner=arwdDxt/lys_owner lys_reader=r/lys_owner
  column id bigint not null default nextval('lys.game_events_id_seq'::regclass)
  column occurred_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  column user_id text not null
  column username citext not null
  column channel_id text not null
  column channel_name text not null
  column game_code text not null
  column raw_message text not null
  column details jsonb
  column is_flagged boolean not null default false
  constraint game_events_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  index CREATE INDEX game_events_oneuppuzzle_channel_time_idx ON lys.game_events USING btree (channel_id, (((details ->> 'time_seconds'::text))::integer)) WHERE ((game_code = 'oneuppuzzle'::text) AND (is_flagged = false))
  index CREATE INDEX game_events_oneuppuzzle_user_puzzle_idx ON lys.game_events USING btree (user_id, (((details ->> 'puzzle_id'::text))::integer)) WHERE (game_code = 'oneuppuzzle'::text)
  index CREATE INDEX game_events_oneuppuzzle_username_idx ON lys.game_events USING btree (username) WHERE ((game_code = 'oneuppuzzle'::text) AND (is_flagged = false))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX game_events_pkey ON lys.game_events USING btree (id)
table letterboxd_feed_subscriptions owner=lys_owner acl=lys_app=arwd/lys_owner lys_owner=arwdDxt/lys_owner lys_reader=r/lys_owner
  column id bigint not null default nextval('lys.feeds_id_seq'::regclass)
  column username text not null
  column user_id text not null
  column letterboxd_username character varying(255) not null
  column feed_url text not null
  column last_seen_guid text
  column last_alerted_at timestamp with time zone
  column created_at timestamp with time zone default now()
  column alert_channels text[] not null default '{}'::text[]
  constraint feeds_feed_url_key UNIQUE (feed_url)
  constraint feeds_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint feeds_user_id_letterboxd_username_key UNIQUE (user_id, letterboxd_username)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX feeds_feed_url_key ON lys.letterboxd_feed_subscriptions USING btree (feed_url)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX feeds_pkey ON lys.letterboxd_feed_subscriptions USING btree (id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX feeds_user_id_letterboxd_username_key ON lys.letterboxd_feed_subscriptions USING btree (user_id, letterboxd_username)
table sleeper_connections owner=lys_owner acl=lys_app=arwd/lys_owner lys_owner=arwdDxt/lys_owner lys_reader=r/lys_owner
  column id uuid not null default gen_random_uuid()
  column league_id uuid not null
  column twitch_user_id text not null
  column sleeper_user_id text not null
  column sleeper_username text
  column sleeper_roster_id integer not null
  column created_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  column twitch_username text
  constraint sleeper_connections_league_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (league_id) REFERENCES lys.sleeper_leagues(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint sleeper_connections_league_id_sleeper_roster_id_key UNIQUE (league_id, sleeper_roster_id)
  constraint sleeper_connections_league_id_twitch_user_id_key UNIQUE (league_id, twitch_user_id)
  constraint sleeper_connections_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sleeper_connections_league_id_sleeper_roster_id_key ON lys.sleeper_connections USING btree (league_id, sleeper_roster_id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sleeper_connections_league_id_twitch_user_id_key ON lys.sleeper_connections USING btree (league_id, twitch_user_id)
  index CREATE INDEX sleeper_connections_league_twitch_username_idx ON lys.sleeper_connections USING btree (league_id, lower(twitch_username))
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sleeper_connections_pkey ON lys.sleeper_connections USING btree (id)
table sleeper_events owner=lys_owner acl=lys_app=arwd/lys_owner lys_owner=arwdDxt/lys_owner lys_reader=r/lys_owner
  column id uuid not null default gen_random_uuid()
  column sleeper_league_id text not null
  column event_type text not null
  column external_event_id text
  column event_data jsonb
  column occurred_at timestamp with time zone not null
  column published_at timestamp with time zone
  column created_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  constraint sleeper_events_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint sleeper_events_sleeper_league_id_event_type_external_event__key UNIQUE (sleeper_league_id, event_type, external_event_id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sleeper_events_pkey ON lys.sleeper_events USING btree (id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sleeper_events_sleeper_league_id_event_type_external_event__key ON lys.sleeper_events USING btree (sleeper_league_id, event_type, external_event_id)
table sleeper_leagues owner=lys_owner acl=lys_app=arwd/lys_owner lys_owner=arwdDxt/lys_owner lys_reader=r/lys_owner
  column id uuid not null default gen_random_uuid()
  column twitch_channel_id text not null
  column sleeper_league_id text not null
  column league_name text
  column season text
  column enabled boolean not null default true
  column current_week integer
  column last_polled_at timestamp with time zone
  column last_transaction_at timestamp with time zone
  column last_waiver_week integer
  column last_recap_week integer
  column notifications jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb
  column created_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  column updated_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  constraint sleeper_leagues_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint sleeper_leagues_twitch_channel_id_sleeper_league_id_key UNIQUE (twitch_channel_id, sleeper_league_id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sleeper_leagues_pkey ON lys.sleeper_leagues USING btree (id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sleeper_leagues_twitch_channel_id_sleeper_league_id_key ON lys.sleeper_leagues USING btree (twitch_channel_id, sleeper_league_id)
table twitch_channel_events owner=lys_owner acl=lys_app=arwd/lys_owner lys_owner=arwdDxt/lys_owner lys_reader=r/lys_owner
  column event_id uuid not null default gen_random_uuid()
  column user_id text not null
  column username citext not null
  column action lys.channel_action not null
  column occurred_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  constraint channel_events_pkey PRIMARY KEY (event_id)
  constraint twitch_channel_events_user_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES lys.twitch_channels(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX channel_events_pkey ON lys.twitch_channel_events USING btree (event_id)
  index CREATE INDEX idx_channel_events_recent ON lys.twitch_channel_events USING btree (occurred_at DESC)
table twitch_channels owner=lys_owner acl=lys_app=arwd/lys_owner lys_owner=arwdDxt/lys_owner lys_reader=r/lys_owner
  column user_id text not null
  column username citext not null
  column access_token text not null
  column refresh_token text not null
  column date_joined timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  column last_joined timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  column active boolean not null default true
  column times_joined integer not null default 1
  column banned boolean not null default false
  constraint channels_pkey PRIMARY KEY (user_id)
  constraint channels_username_key UNIQUE (username)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX channels_pkey ON lys.twitch_channels USING btree (user_id)
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX channels_username_key ON lys.twitch_channels USING btree (username)
  index CREATE INDEX idx_channels_active ON lys.twitch_channels USING btree (active)
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER twitch_channels_after_insert AFTER INSERT ON lys.twitch_channels FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION lys.create_twitch_settings_entry()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER twitch_channels_after_insert_log AFTER INSERT ON lys.twitch_channels FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION lys.log_twitch_channel_changes()
  trigger CREATE TRIGGER twitch_channels_after_update_log AFTER UPDATE OF active, banned ON lys.twitch_channels FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((old.active IS DISTINCT FROM new.active) OR (old.banned IS DISTINCT FROM new.banned))) EXECUTE FUNCTION lys.log_twitch_channel_changes()
table twitch_settings owner=lys_owner acl=lys_app=arwd/lys_owner lys_owner=arwdDxt/lys_owner lys_reader=r/lys_owner
  column user_id text not null
  column command_prefix text not null default '!'::text
  column date_created timestamp without time zone default now()
  column last_modified timestamp without time zone default now()
  constraint twitch_settings_pkey PRIMARY KEY (user_id)
  constraint twitch_settings_user_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES lys.twitch_channels(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX twitch_settings_pkey ON lys.twitch_settings USING btree (user_id)
sequence feature_requests_id_seq owner=lys_owner acl=lys_app=rU/lys_owner lys_owner=rwU/lys_owner type=bigint start=1 increment=1 min=1 max=9223372036854775807 cache=1 cycle=f owned_by=feature_requests.id
sequence feeds_id_seq owner=lys_owner acl=lys_app=rU/lys_owner lys_owner=rwU/lys_owner type=bigint start=1 increment=1 min=1 max=9223372036854775807 cache=1 cycle=f owned_by=letterboxd_feed_subscriptions.id
sequence game_events_id_seq owner=lys_owner acl=lys_app=rU/lys_owner lys_owner=rwU/lys_owner type=bigint start=1 increment=1 min=1 max=9223372036854775807 cache=1 cycle=f owned_by=game_events.id
